name: Hive Backed Dollar
oneLiner: HBD is Hive's algorithmic dollar, redeemable on-chain for $1 of HIVE via a witness-set conversion, with haircut rules when system debt exceeds thresholds.
collateral: Hive protocol value and conversion rules between HBD and HIVE, including haircut logic when HBD debt exceeds protocol thresholds
pegMechanism: Protocol-level conversion mechanism targets one U.S. dollar of HIVE per HBD, with witness-set interest and haircut rules under stress

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hive's official HBD disclosure and consensus implementation establish no exogenous reserve claim: the $1 target is defended by permissionless HIVE/HBD conversions, a witness-median price feed, automatic print-stop thresholds, and a debt-limit haircut. Because stabilization and value realization depend on the protocol's native HIVE asset and consensus rules, HBD is an endogenous, reflexive algorithmic design.

notices.title: Protocol haircut mechanism
notices.message: HBD redemptions depend on Hive protocol conversion rules and can be haircut when system debt is above configured thresholds.

notices.title: Hive-native asset
notices.message: HBD is issued by the Hive protocol rather than an EVM-style token contract. Pharos does not list a contract address until Hive is supported in the chain metadata registry.
